note: Choices and doubts for the native reviewer. (1) Terms: the Mother = 母亲 (formal, distant; never 妈妈, to keep it apart from Mama Marina); her 'little ones' = 小宝贝们 everywhere (flyer bubble, the owner's quote in the 1997 clipping, the 'moved' death, finale), while the English slogan stays in English as the brief says. The boy's own mother in the 15 August clipping is 孩子的母亲 (newspaper style); the echo with 母亲 is deliberate but could be changed to 孩子的妈妈. Journal = 日志, Catalogue = 图鉴 (the usual word for a game's collection book), quota = 配额 (the word Chinese players know from Lethal Company; 指标 is the alternative). (2) Typography: full-width punctuation; a half-width space between Chinese and Latin-letter words (Gulpy, Splashland, key names). The spaces are also needed by the radio voice: src/engine/voice.ts splits words on spaces, and a name stuck to Chinese characters would not be spoken. Drawing names use 《》 (the title of a work) in `quotes`; 'pageAbbr' is empty because Chinese books print the page number alone (the code writes `${pageAbbr} ${n}`). 'Notte 1' in the HUD becomes 夜晚 1, because the code puts the number after the word and cannot produce 第1夜; the radio says 第一夜. (3) Radio: each line has as many syllables as the Italian or fewer (one character = one syllable), except 祝你满载而归 (6 against 4), 然后待在黑暗里，等他沉下去 (12/10), 归零，就黑。黑了，她就唱歌 (10/9) and Fangy 看不见。他听得见 (9/7). All of these still fit their window at the voice's normal pace. (4) Hatch's hide-and-seek formula is 藏好了没？我来啦！; the counting sheet in Hatch's den says 藏好了没, the first half, as IT/EN do. Marco Polo is 马可·波罗 and Fangy's death line is “马可。”你回答了; the image itself keeps MARCO!/POLO! in Latin letters. Lampy's radio line 放开她，让她走 and the hospital bracelet 永远别放开她 deliberately echo each other, as in Italian (Lasciala andare / non lasciarla mai andare). (5) Crayon texts: the draft 我的宝贝 became 我的宝藏 (Robin's hoard of stolen things; also avoids an echo with 小宝贝们, the Mother's children); 哈哈哈 became 嘻嘻嘻 (a cheeky giggle, like Lampy's risatina; 哈哈哈 is fine too if preferred). Robin is a boy, but Chinese does not mark gender here. (6) Flyer: title 我们在找你！ ('we are looking for you', closer to CERCHIAMO TE and with the same double meaning) instead of the draft 我们需要你！; 旧码头 became 老码头 (more natural as a place name); hours 午夜至清晨6点 and pay line 天亮现金结算 are shorter than the draft. The ribbon keeps • because ZCOOL QingKe HuangYou has no ·. Because the texts changed, the CJK font subsets of the flyer must be rebuilt before rendering (annuncio.py --sottoinsiemi <folder with the full fonts>, then annuncio.py --controlla). The game's own subset (tools/fonts/sottoinsieme_cjk.py zh) also has to be rebuilt once this file is wired in. Every character in zh.ts exists in Noto Serif SC, including the two CJK Extension A characters 䲟 (remora) and 䲢 (weever). (7) Fish names: puns on the Chinese species names, mostly homophones or swapped characters: 鲭空 = 清空 'emptied out' (like sgombro → sgombrato), 无鼻鳕 from 无须鳕, 大陵鲆 sounds like 大菱鲆 (陵 = mausoleum), 半身鰤 (鰤 shī sounds like 尸 'corpse'), 双面鳐 sounds like 双面妖 'two-faced demon', 淤青鲨 from 大青鲨 (bruise), 假牙鲷 from 牙鲷 (dentures), 静电鳐 from 电鳐, 钉背鳐 from 背棘鳐, 血鳍金枪鱼 from 蓝鳍金枪鱼, 复读鹦哥 ('repeater' parrotfish), 脓包河豚 (脓包 also means coward: the puffer must not be scared), 多嘴鲨 (many mouths / blabbermouth), 死灰鲨 (the idiom 死灰复燃, dead ashes rekindling). The opah's Chinese name is 月鱼 ('moonfish'), so its description puts the mouth in the middle of the moon instead of in place of the crown (the Italian joke rests on pesce re). (8) Real species names: FishBase and Wikipedia were not reachable from this session, so names come from FAO AGROVOC (via search results) and memory. These are confirmed: 黍鲱, 牛眼鲷, 细鳞棒鲈, 黑斑棒鲈, 颌针鱼, 贝氏隆头鱼, 叉牙鲷, 纹首鮨, 细条石颌鲷, 褐鳕 (genus name), 镰鳍波线鲹, 背棘鳐, 长吻鱼, 星鲨, 沙重牙鲷, 欧洲鳎, 大西洋叉尾带鱼, 博耶银汉鱼, 黑尾斑鲷, 克里特鹦嘴鱼, 地中海海鳝 (also called 海伦海鳝) and 乌鳍石斑鱼. No standard Chinese name was found for these, so they are built from the correct genus or family name plus the English descriptor; please check them: 大西洋狗母鱼 (Synodus saurus), 斑点灯笼鱼 (Myctophum punctatum), 长吻海马 (Hippocampus guttulatus), 鹞鲼 (Myliobatis aquila, genus name), 暗色石首鱼 (Sciaena umbra), 普通魟 (Dasyatis pastinaca), 须石首鱼 (Umbrina cirrosa), 欧洲银鲛 (Chimaera monstrosa), 须羊鱼 / 条纹羊鱼 (Mullus barbatus / surmuletus), 地中海盔鱼 (Coris julis), 地中海光鳃鱼 (Chromis chromis), 绯小鲷 / 黑斑小鲷 (Pagellus erythrinus / bogaraveo), 珍珠项鳍鱼 (Xyrichtys novacula), 大西洋飞角鱼 (Dactylopterus volitans), 地中海燕鳐 (Cheilopogon heterurus), 副鳚 (Parablennius gattorugine, genus name), 黑鲉 / 红鲉 (Scorpaena porcus / scrofa), 绿鳍鱼 (Chelidonichthys lucerna, genus name), 大西洋瞻星鱼 (Uranoscopus scaber), 腔吻鳕 (Coelorinchus caelorhincus, genus name), 白鳐 (Rostroraja alba), 龙䲢 (Trachinus draco), 赤鲷 (Pagrus pagrus; FAO gives 真鲷, which Chinese readers take as Pagrus major), 环带重牙鲷 (Diplodus annularis) and 欧洲金梭鱼 (Sphyraena sphyraena).
